noun-021.text: oculus → ocular. Ocular means relating to the eyes; picture an ocular lens. The dictionary form oculus means eye.

noun-043.text: ager, agrī → agriculture. Agriculture involves cultivating fields. The agr- connection can remind you that ager means field.

noun-004.text: agricola → agriculture. Connect the farmer on this card with agriculture and working in fields. This is a memory aid, not a translation of agriculture.

noun-030.text: aqua → aquatic. Aquatic animals live in water; aqua means water.

noun-002.text: pater → paternal. Paternal means relating to a father; pater means father.

noun-027.text: māter → maternal. Maternal means relating to a mother; māter means mother.
